{{Top|leg}}
'''RH8 laser cannon'''{{'s}} were the primary anti-[[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] weaponry onboard [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|KDY]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B frigates]], which normally mounted twelve such [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] emplacements. They were manufactured by [[Borstel Galactic Defense/Legends|Borstel Galactic Defense]].<ref name="FP">{{StoryCite|story=The Farlander Papers|book=Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)}}</ref>
